verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a serverless platform that hosts data stores such as KV and D1, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no export capability (no D1 or KV export, no bulk data download, no open-format dumps). The marketing line "No proprietary tools or vendor lock-in" is about fitting into existing developer workflows, not about exporting data, so it is adjacent at most. Community remarks that KV and D1 lock-in makes switching hard reinforce the gap, but they are not a contradiction of any documented export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
